result.instructions: Tools for LastFolk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Price a same-day delivery from our shop to a customer across town."; "Dispatch the delivery for order 10482 and tell me its tracking link."; "Which of today's deliveries are still waiting for the courier to pick up?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LastFolk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run lastfolk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lastfolk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lastfolk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. lastfolk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lastfolk_whoami
tools.title: Check API key identity
tools.description: Show which LastFolk tenant and environment (sandbox or production) this API key belongs to, plus the key prefix and last four characters. Use it to confirm the key works. GET /v1/whoami.

tools.name: lastfolk_check_environment
tools.title: Check key and courier account environment
tools.description: Check that the API key environment matches the connected courier provider account, before any delivery is created. Returns match: true when they agree. A mismatch is an error. GET /v1/environment.

annotations.title: Check key and courier account environment

tools.name: lastfolk_create_quote
tools.title: Price a delivery quote
tools.description: Price a pickup-to-dropoff delivery and get a quote_id. Reserves nothing and charges nothing. The quote is single-use and expires at expires_at; pass quote_id to lastfolk_create_delivery before then. Price amounts are decimal strings: never parse them as floats. POST /v1/quotes.

address.description: Full human-readable address line. Shown in LastFolk surfaces.

street_address.description: Street line ONLY: no city and no country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example CL. Required: it is never inferred.

state.description: Subdivision, where the country uses one.

pickup.description: Where the courier collects the order.

tools.name: lastfolk_list_deliveries
tools.title: List deliveries
tools.description: List your deliveries, newest first, with status, tracking URL and ETAs. Filter by status, your external_order_id, or a created date range. Page with next_cursor. The dropoff PIN is not in lists: use lastfolk_get_delivery. GET /v1/deliveries.

status.description: Only these statuses. Repeat values to match several.

external_order_id.description: Your own order id. Not unique: returns every match.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

tools.name: lastfolk_get_delivery
tools.title: Get delivery details
tools.description: Read one delivery: status, tracking URL, ETAs, timestamps, and the dropoff verification_pin the recipient gives the courier. The PIN is a secret: share it only with the recipient. GET /v1/deliveries/{delivery_id}.

delivery_id.description: The delivery_id returned when the delivery was created.

tools.name: lastfolk_create_delivery
tools.title: Dispatch a delivery (creates a courier job)
tools.description: DISPATCHES a real courier job against a quote_id from lastfolk_create_quote, and starts the billing for it. The quote must be unused and not expired. Use a unique idempotency_key per delivery (an order id works): a retry with the same key and body returns the original delivery and never dispatches a second courier. The same key with a different body is refused. dropoff.phone must be a real, reachable number. POST /v1/deliveries.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per delivery attempt, 1 to 255 characters, sent as the Idempotency-Key header. An order id works.

external_order_id.description: Your own order reference. Echoed on the delivery and in webhooks.

phone.description: Recipient phone, E.164. The courier calls this number.

pickup_notes.description: Instructions for the courier at pickup.

manifest.description: Optional declared contents of the shipment.

price.description: Per-unit price in subunits x100 of the order currency (CLP 12.500 is 1250000).

items.description: Declared lines. Aggregate lines instead of one line per unit.

total_value.description: Declared goods value in subunits x100 of the order currency.

annotations.title: Dispatch a delivery (creates a courier job)

tools.name: lastfolk_cancel_delivery
tools.title: Cancel a delivery
tools.description: Cancel a delivery that the courier has not collected yet (status pending or pickup). Cancelling a delivery that is already cancelled succeeds with changed: false. After pickup, the API refuses with delivery_not_cancellable. Cancelling moves no money in the same call. POST /v1/deliveries/{delivery_id}/cancel.

tools.name: lastfolk_get_billing_profile
tools.title: Get billing profile
tools.description: Read the account's fiscal identity: legal company name, tax ID and type, and billing address. Exactly seven fields, each text or null. GET /v1/billing-profile.

tools.name: lastfolk_update_billing_profile
tools.title: Update billing profile
tools.description: Change the account's fiscal identity. Fields you omit or send empty keep their stored value. Send null to clear one field. The tax ID is checked against the resulting billing country, and the whole update is refused if it fails. Changes flow to billing records and invoices. PUT /v1/billing-profile.
